scenes.title: BLACK HOLES ARE REAL
scenes.say: Black holes are real. But why do they even exist?

scenes.title: WHERE DO THEY COME FROM?
scenes.say: Where does a black hole come from? A star dies, a planet explodes, or space rips open? Pause and guess.

scenes.sub: But only a really big one
scenes.say: It's A. A giant star dies.

scenes.title: A star is a tug of war
scenes.say: A star is a tug of war. Gravity pulls in, burning fuel pushes out.

scenes.title: Fuel runs out. Gravity wins.
scenes.say: When a huge star runs out of fuel, gravity wins. The core collapses in less than a second.

scenes.title: Not even light escapes
scenes.say: It gets so dense that not even light is fast enough to escape. That's a black hole.

scenes.label: Earth squeezed into a black hole
scenes.src: about the size of a marble
scenes.say: Squeeze anything enough and it becomes one. Earth would shrink to about the size of a marble.

scenes.title: CAN OUR SUN BECOME A BLACK HOLE?
scenes.say: So can our Sun become a black hole? Comment yes or no. Answer in part two.
